narrative:

Your occupation—management/self-employed/highly skilled—was the third most important factor and worked in your favor, reflecting stronger earning capacity. Even with those two favorable points, the overdrawn checking account and the overall mix of risk signals were enough to keep the assessed risk above the bank’s limit.

Strengthen your case with proof of stable income or business earnings, build savings, and ask the bank whether a guarantor or co-applicant would help.
